const patch="*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""Camera-guided controller for this single CloseSingleDoor episode.
+
+The commands below use only the public robot client, RGB-D observations, camera
+calibration, and proprioception.  The command line interface makes each motion
+short enough to inspect before deciding on the next one.
+"""
+
+import argparse
+import json
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+
+ROOT = Path('/app/runs')
+
+
+def snapshot(robot, name, cameras=None, depth=True):
+    cameras = cameras or list(robot.spec()['cameras'])
+    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=cameras, include_depth=depth, video='none')
+    obs.save(str(ROOT / name))
+    report(obs)
+    return obs
+
+
+def report(obs):
+    m = obs.meta
+    p = dict(zip(m['proprio']['layout'], m['proprio']['now']))
+    print(json.dumps({
+        'steps': m['control_steps'], 'time_left_s': m['time_left_s'],
+        'eef': [p['eef_right_x'], p['eef_right_y'], p['eef_right_z']],
+        'base': [p['mobilebase0_joint_mobile_forward_pos'],
+                 p['mobilebase0_joint_mobile_side_pos'],
+                 p['mobilebase0_joint_mobile_yaw_pos']],
+        'torso': p['mobilebase0_joint_torso_height_pos'],
+        'done': m['done'], 'reason': m['reason'],
+    }, indent=2))
+
+
+def move(robot, name, rows, cameras=None):
+    cameras = cameras or list(robot.spec()['cameras'])
+    a = np.array(rows, dtype=np.float64)
+    result = robot.submit('ee_delta', a, cameras=cameras, include_depth=True,
+                          video='none', interpolate='hold', note=name)
+    result.save(str(ROOT / name))
+    report(result)
+    return result
+
+
+def arm_row(dx=0, dy=0, dz=0, drx=0, dry=0, drz=0, grip=-1,
+            bx=0, by=0, byaw=0, torso=0, mode=-1):
+    return [dx, dy, dz, drx, dry, drz, grip, bx, by, byaw, torso, mode]
+
+
+if __name__ == '__main__':
+    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
+    parser.add_argument('name')
+    parser.add_argument('--rows', type=int, default=0)
+    parser.add_argument('--dx', type=float, default=0)
+    parser.add_argument('--dy', type=float, default=0)
+    parser.add_argument('--dz', type=float, default=0)
+    parser.add_argument('--drx', type=float, default=0)
+    parser.add_argument('--dry', type=float, default=0)
+    parser.add_argument('--drz', type=float, default=0)
+    parser.add_argument('--grip', type=float, default=-1)
+    parser.add_argument('--bx', type=float, default=0)
+    parser.add_argument('--by', type=float, default=0)
+    parser.add_argument('--byaw', type=float, default=0)
+    parser.add_argument('--torso', type=float, default=0)
+    parser.add_argument('--mode', type=float, default=-1)
+    parser.add_argument('--cameras', nargs='*')
+    args = parser.parse_args()
+    robot = Robot()
+    if args.rows == 0:
+        snapshot(robot, args.name, args.cameras)
+    else:
+        row = arm_row(args.dx, args.dy, args.dz, args.drx, args.dry,
+                      args.drz, args.grip, args.bx, args.by, args.byaw,
+                      args.torso, args.mode)
+        move(robot, args.name, [row] * args.rows, args.cameras)
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));
